claims.claim: The resumed Claude session d964ad07 is a UVISA 2.0 fullstack work session spanning frontend, backend, and local-brain taskpool context.
The project profile should further harden default fullstack-integrated execution: backend-owned semantics require backend inspection and direct backend changes when backend is the correct fix point.
The project profile should include the prototype URL https://napp.denatrust.com as a UI/prototype comparison anchor and label it non-real-backend/non-integration evidence.

The project profile should clarify Lark evidence precedence: real Lark task text/comments/PM screenshots/prototype anchors are evidence sources; generated taskpool description placeholders are not authoritative requirements, and conflicts must be recorded rather than silently resolved.

The project profile should encode release branch sync: frontend publishes from feat/uvisa-2.0 and backend from main; on explicit release sync request, rebase/push both scoped branches with tests/evidence.
For local fullstack UI acceptance, the profile should require local backend + local frontend + browser/Playwright evidence, with mock/Railway only comparison/monitoring evidence.
Profile update should avoid raw transcript dumps, credentials, OTPs, cookies, and secrets; only compact redacted evidence and durable workflow rules should be persisted.
